versions.content: Read user defined memory snapshot record authentication check On reception of the UDS Service ReadDTCInformation (0x19) with sub- function reportUserDefMemoryDTCSnapshotRecordByDTCNumber (0x18), the Dcm shall check if the access to the selected user defined memory in parameter MemoryS- election is authenticated and read the DTC information only if: • a DcmDspReadDTCInformationUserDefinedFaultMemoryRole is configured with DcmDspReadDTCInformationUserDefinedFaultMemoryRoleId matching the MemorySelection and the verification according to [SWS_Dcm_01522] was suc- cessful or • the active white list on that connection has for that requested user defined mem- ory selection one entry.
